content.text:
**None — Basket.API has no integration event handler that updates prices of items in a customer's basket.**

How I established this:

- Basket.API contains exactly one integration event handler class in the whole project: `OrderStartedIntegrationEventHandler` (`src/Basket.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStartedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:6`). It implements `IIntegrationEventHandler<OrderStartedIntegrationEvent>` and its only action is `repository.DeleteBasketAsync(@event.UserId)` — it deletes the basket, it does not reprice anything (`src/Basket.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStartedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:10-15`).
- A repo-wide search for `IIntegrationEventHandler` under `src/Basket.API` returns only that one file, and the event-bus wiring registers only that single subscription: `builder.AddRabbitMqEventBus("eventbus").AddSubscription<OrderStartedIntegrationEvent, OrderStartedIntegrationEventHandler>()` (`src/Basket.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:18-19`). There is no `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent` subscription in Basket.API.
- The price-change event does exist elsewhere: Catalog.API publishes `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent` when a price is edited (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:350`, `src/Catalog.API/IntegrationEvents/Events/ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent.cs:6`), and the only subscriber in the solution is in Webhooks.API (`src/Webhooks.API/IntegrationEvents/ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:3`, registered at `src/Webhooks.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:21`) — that handler dispatches webhooks, not basket price updates. A case-insensitive search for "PriceChanged" across the repo produced no hits in Basket.API at all.

Note: some eShop versions/branches ship a `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEventHandler` in Basket.API that rewrites `BasketItem.OldUnitPrice`/`UnitPrice`; in this checkout that handler is absent (Catalog.API even has a placeholder stub file `src/Catalog.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/AnyFutureIntegrationEventHandler.cs.txt:3` noting "To implement ProductPriceChangedEvent.cs here").
